name: 麻醉镖
description: 弹射物：向同一行或同一列发射麻醉镖（无法穿过掩体和角色）。命中路径上的第1个敌人后，使其睡眠2回合。睡眠期间，目标不能移动或使用技能；受到伤害后会提前解除。
targetText: 同一行或同一列的1个方向
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var targetPos = selectTarget({ type: 'grid', range: 99, filter: 'all' }); if (!targetPos || targetPos.needsTargetSelection) return targetPos; var dx = targetPos.x - caster.x; var dy = targetPos.y - caster.y; if (dx !== 0 && dy !== 0) { return { success: false, message: '麻醉镖只能向同一行或同一列方向发射' }; } if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) { return { success: false, message: '不能选择自身所在格' }; } var direction = { x: dx === 0 ? 0 : (dx > 0 ? 1 : -1), y: dy === 0 ? 0 : (dy > 0 ? 1 : -1) }; var events = traceProjectile({ x: caster.x, y: caster.y }, direction, { excludePieceId: caster.instanceId }); for (var i = 0; i < events.length; i++) { var event = events[i]; if (event.type === 'piece') { var target = event.piece; if (target.ownerPlayerId !== caster.ownerPlayerId) { var statusId = 'sleep-' + Date.now(); addStatusEffectById(target.instanceId, { id: statusId, type: 'sleep', currentDuration: 2, intensity: 1, relatedRules: ['rule-sleep-prevent-move', 'rule-sleep-prevent-skill', 'rule-sleep-remove-on-damage'] }); addRuleById(target.instanceId, 'rule-sleep-prevent-move'); addRuleById(target.instanceId, 'rule-sleep-prevent-skill'); addRuleById(target.instanceId, 'rule-sleep-remove-on-damage'); addSkillById(target.instanceId, 'sleep-prevent'); addSkillById(target.instanceId, 'sleep-remove'); return { success: true, message: caster.name + '的麻醉镖命中' + target.name + '，使其进入睡眠状态2回合' }; } return { success: true, message: '麻醉镖被' + target.name + '阻挡，未对友军生效' }; } if (event.type === 'terrain' && event.blocksProjectile) { return { success: true, message: '麻醉镖被地形阻挡，未命中任何敌人' }; } } return { success: true, message: '麻醉镖未命中任何敌人' }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece, skillDef) { return { description: '向同一行或同一列发射麻醉镖。命中路径上的第1个敌人后，使其睡眠2回合。', expectedValues: {} }; }
